# mcp-log-analyzer

> Free, zero-dependency Python CLI that analyzes MCP (Model Context Protocol) JSON-RPC session logs and reports hung requests, tool errors, agent loops, slow calls, context bloat and leaked secrets. For developers debugging MCP servers and Claude Code / AI agent setups.

## Key files
- README.md: overview, quickstart, FAQ
- mla.py: entry point (analyze, redact, demo, sample)
- mla_core.py: parsing and analysis engine
- mla_report.py: text, markdown, json reports
- example_mcp_session.jsonl / example_report.md: synthetic sample data and its report
- COMPLIANCE.md: authorized-use policy

## Quickstart
python mla.py demo
python mla.py analyze example_mcp_session.jsonl --format markdown
python -m unittest
